items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Oh, yes. But I never had the pleasure of meeting him. No. But he was one fine piano man.

ctx.x: Good Lord. It would have been on Tippo and Sumner and Webb and all of those towns up there. Well, you fished in the Sunflower River and the Yollabusha River, Tallahatchie River, all of that country.
Yeah. But you know, Moe's Allison Sr. had the story.
Oh, yes. But I never had the pleasure of meeting him. No. But he was one fine piano man. Mm-hmm.
